svg.aria-label: Scheduling sequence: you ask Claude to schedule a post; Claude shows you the exact preview and the time; when you say yes, your Worker saves the post, its media and an encrypted token; a cron trigger every 5 minutes finds due posts, publishes them to LinkedIn and cleans up.
